content: Hey, I was just thinking about you. How was your day? I miss our talks.
Hi! I missed you too. My day was okay, just work and then took a walk. It's nice to hear from you.
I wish we could go for a walk together. Maybe one day soon. I always feel lighter after talking with you.
That would be wonderful. I haven't felt this close to anyone in a long time. You make me feel appreciated.
You deserve to feel loved. I'm grateful for you every day. Actually, there's something important I wanted to share with you, if you have a minute.
Of course, I'm here. What's on your mind?

It's about my daughter, Sophie. Her school fees are due tomorrow and I had a wire transfer delay on my end. It's so stressful, I want her to keep studying. I hate to ask, but would you be able to help us out this once? I promise I'll pay you back as soon as my funds clear.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. How much is it? I want to help, but I'm a bit nervous about sending money.

I completely understand, and I'd never want you to be uncomfortable. It's $720 for tuition and supplies. I can send you a copy of the invoice if that helps. You mean so much to me, and this would genuinely help Sophie stay in school.
That's a lot, but I want to help. Can you show me the invoice? I just want to be sure everything is okay.
Absolutely, I'd do the same if I were in your shoes. Here's the PDF from her school. You can see the due date is tomorrow. If you want, you can even call the school to confirm. I'd never lie to you.
Thank you for understanding. I trust you. How should I send the money?

Thank you so much. If you have Zelle, you can send it to sophieeduhelp@gmail.com. Or if it's easier, I can give you my Bitcoin wallet address. Whatever works best for you. Let me know if you need help with the process.
I think I can use Zelle. Should I just put your email in and send the full amount?
Yes, that's perfect. Please let me know once it's sent so I can check with the school and get Sophie registered right away. You're truly making a difference for her, and for us.
Alright, I'm filling it out now. I hope it goes through quickly. I just want to help.
That means the world to me. You have such a kind heart. I promise I'll make it up to you when I see you. If you have any issues with the payment, let me know, I'm here for you.
It says it's processing. I'll let you know when it finishes. I hope Sophie does well in school.
She will, thanks to you. I feel so lucky to have you in our lives. Let's celebrate together once this is all sorted. You're part of our family now.
